credit: Source: GeoNames, Argentine postal code dump, 13 October 2026.
identity: one row per postcode and locality; a row is kept when the dump lists its locality under the same code, exactly or after an accent, case and punctuation fold
changes_by_csc: Existing rows the dump lists were kept and took its locality name, point and state; a field the dump's rows disagree on is left empty; points formatted to eight decimals; no new codes added; city links cleared, as the dump carries no Correo locality id to re-derive them.
state_mapping: Postal admin1 is the ISO province letter, mapped to the CSC state iso2 (https://www.geonames.org/AR/administrative-division-argentina.html)
